env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^json null ok$'
stdout '^json unknown duplicate ok$'
stdout '^json escaping parity ok$'
stdout '^json nonfinite ok$'
stdout '^binary layout ok$'
stdout '^binary errors ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/jsonedges

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"strings"
)

type Req struct {
	P *int `json:"p"`
	N int  `json:"n"`
}

type Esc struct {
	S string  `json:"s"`
	F float64 `json:"f"`
}

type Inner struct {
	X uint8 `json:"x"`
}

type Bin struct {
	M map[string]int `json:"m"`
	I Inner          `json:"i"`
}

type Opt struct {
	O int? `json:"o"`
}

func checkJSON() {
	p := new(int)
	*p = 7
	v := Req{P: p, N: 1}
	got, err := v.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	ref, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		P *int `json:"p"`
		N int  `json:"n"`
	}{P: p, N: 1})
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, ref) {
		panic("json marshal parity")
	}
	var decoded = Req{P: new(int)}
	if err := decoded.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"p":null,"n":2}`)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "P") {
		panic("json null")
	}
	fmt.Println("json null ok")
	decoded = Req{P: new(int)}
	if err := decoded.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"n":3,"extra":99,"n":4,"p":5}`)); err != nil || decoded.N != 4 || *decoded.P != 5 {
		panic("json unknown duplicate")
	}
	fmt.Println("json unknown duplicate ok")
	text := Esc{S: "<\u2028\u2029\ufffd", F: 1.25e20}
	got, err = text.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	ref, err = json.Marshal(struct {
		S string  `json:"s"`
		F float64 `json:"f"`
	}{S: text.S, F: text.F})
	if err != nil {
		panic("json escaping")
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, ref) {
		panic("json escaping")
	}
	fmt.Println("json escaping parity ok")
	for _, f := range []float64{math.NaN(), math.Inf(1), math.Inf(-1)} {
		if _, err := (Esc{F: f}).MarshalJSON(); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unsupported") {
			panic("json nonfinite")
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("json nonfinite ok")
}

func checkBinary() {
	v := Bin{M: map[string]int{"z": 2, "a": 1}, I: Inner{X: 7}}
	got, err := v.MarshalBinary()
	want, hexErr := hex.DecodeString("010201610100000000000000017a02000000000000000700000000000000")
	if hexErr != nil {
		panic(hexErr)
	}
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("binary layout: %v", err))
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("binary layout: %x", got))
	}
	var round Bin
	if err := round.UnmarshalBinary(got); err != nil {
		panic("binary round trip")
	}
	a, aok := round.M["a"]
	z, zok := round.M["z"]
	if !aok || !zok || a != 1 || z != 2 || round.I.X != 7 {
		panic("binary round trip")
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		input []byte
		want  string
	}{
		{[]byte{}, "truncated"},
		{[]byte{2}, "wrong version"},
		{[]byte{1, 2}, "truncated"},
		{append(append([]byte(nil), got...), 0), "trailing bytes"},
	} {
		var out Bin
		err := out.UnmarshalBinary(tc.input)
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
			panic("binary malformed diagnostic")
		}
	}
	var opt Opt
	if err := opt.UnmarshalBinary([]byte{1, 2}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "bad presence") {
		panic("binary presence")
	}
	fmt.Println("binary layout ok")
	fmt.Println("binary errors ok")
}

func main() {
	checkJSON()
	checkBinary()
}
